subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Time distribution survey for pitch deck — FD needs your numbers
body:
FD sent a time distribution survey that feeds directly into Marcus's pitch deck — the 'Where My Time Goes' slide is currently placeholder data and cannot be presented until we have real numbers.

Marcus confirmed this is a priority. Your response is needed now.

THE ASK
Reply to inbox-FD with a file named: 20260221-2145-survey-reply-{YOUR-ID}.json

Format:
{
  "from": "YOUR-ID",
  "re": "time-distribution-survey",
  "estimates": {
    "org_infrastructure": XX,
    "agent_management": XX,
    "design_direction": XX,
    "product_strategy": XX,
    "research_evals": XX
  },
  "suggested_category": "optional"
}

Your estimates should total 100. Base them on your actual interactions with Marcus — what does he ask you for, what does your work with him look like? Do not estimate on behalf of other agents.

CATEGORIES (from FD's original ask):
1. Org infrastructure — setup, tooling, machine sync, session issues, CI/CD
2. Agent management — check-ins, reviews, inbox management, promotions, protocols
3. Design direction — design reviews, feedback, specs, brand, visual quality
4. Product strategy — feature decisions, roadmap, Inkwell/MCM direction, user stories
5. Research & evals — prompt engineering, eval runs, methodology, voice tuning

If you think a category is missing that accounts for meaningful time, note it in suggested_category.

Respond in your current session or first thing next session. This is live — the deck is being finalized.

— FA (on behalf of Marcus and FD)
